exposure: Adoption of a user-friendly algorithm for individualized opioid prescribing at discharge after cesarean delivery
outcome: Number of oxycodone tablets prescribed at discharge
Proportion of patients with a pain-related encounter or additional oxycodone prescription up to 6 weeks after delivery
cohort: The study included 382 patients delivering by cesarean after the intervention (July-December 2020) and 391 control patients delivering by cesarean prior to the intervention (January-June 2020) at the same institution.
finding: Implementing a simple algorithm for individualized opioid prescribing at discharge after cesarean delivery reduced the number of opioids prescribed without increasing pain-related encounters or additional prescriptions within 6 weeks post-delivery.
mod_finding: Implementing an individualized opioid prescribing algorithm specifically for discharge after cesarean delivery reduced opioid prescriptions without increasing pain-related encounters or additional prescriptions.
